import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R

# Helper: average several noisy perception readings to reduce ~1 cm error
def avg_pose(fn, name, n=5):
    ps, qs = [], []
    for _ in range(n):
        p, q = fn(name)
        ps.append(p); qs.append(q)
    ps = np.array(ps); qs = np.array(qs)
    # align quaternion signs to the first sample before averaging
    for i in range(1, n):
        if np.dot(qs[i], qs[0]) < 0:
            qs[i] = -qs[i]
    q = qs.mean(axis=0); q = q / np.linalg.norm(q)
    return ps.mean(axis=0), q

def quat_to_rot(q_wxyz):
    return R.from_quat([q_wxyz[1], q_wxyz[2], q_wxyz[3], q_wxyz[0]]).as_matrix()

# Perceive the nut: center pose and handle grasp pose
nut_center_pos, nut_center_quat = avg_pose(get_object_pose, "white hollow center of the brown square nut")
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = avg_pose(sample_grasp_pose, "extruded handle of the brown square nut")

# Fixed rigid transform from nut center frame to grasp (end-effector) frame
R_nut = quat_to_rot(nut_center_quat)
R_grasp = quat_to_rot(grasp_quat)
t_nut_to_grasp = R_nut.T @ (grasp_pos - nut_center_pos)      # offset in nut frame
R_nut_to_grasp = R_nut.T @ R_grasp                            # rotation in nut frame

# Grasp the nut by its handle
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# Lift the nut up
lift_pos = grasp_pos + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.15])
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Perceive the peg (brown square block)
peg_pos, peg_quat = avg_pose(get_object_pose, "brown square block")

# Target nut center pose: centered on the peg, keep nut orientation (nut and peg are both square;
# use the nut's current yaw-aligned orientation to avoid flipping the grasp).
# Compute yaw difference between nut and peg and rotate the nut about Z to align (mod 90 deg).
yaw_nut = R.from_matrix(R_nut).as_euler('xyz')[2]
yaw_peg = R.from_matrix(quat_to_rot(peg_quat)).as_euler('xyz')[2]
dyaw = (yaw_peg - yaw_nut + np.pi/4) % (np.pi/2) - np.pi/4
R_target_nut = R.from_euler('z', dyaw).as_matrix() @ R_nut

# Target nut center placed above the peg top, then lowered onto it
target_nut_pos_high = peg_pos + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.12])
target_nut_pos_low = peg_pos + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0])

def ee_pose_for_nut(target_nut_pos):
    ee_pos = target_nut_pos + R_target_nut @ t_nut_to_grasp
    R_ee = R_target_nut @ R_nut_to_grasp
    q_xyzw = R.from_matrix(R_ee).as_quat()
    q_wxyz = np.array([q_xyzw[3], q_xyzw[0], q_xyzw[1], q_xyzw[2]])
    return ee_pos, q_wxyz

ee_high_pos, ee_quat = ee_pose_for_nut(target_nut_pos_high)
ee_low_pos, _ = ee_pose_for_nut(target_nut_pos_low)

# Move above the peg, then insert with a vertical approach
goto_pose(ee_high_pos, ee_quat)
goto_pose(ee_low_pos, ee_quat, z_approach=0.08)

# Release the nut and retreat
open_gripper()
goto_pose(ee_high_pos, ee_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
